# seerr_jellyfin_users (Data Source)

Fetch the list of registered users on the connected Jellyfin server for selection and import.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source identifier.
- `total` (Number) Total number of users found on the Jellyfin server.
- `users` (Attributes List) List of users registered on Jellyfin. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) Jellyfin user email address.
- `id` (String) Jellyfin user ID.
- `user_type` (String) User type on Jellyfin.
- `username` (String) Jellyfin username.
